newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish consumption recovering sharply - EconMin.
newsitem.headline: Spanish consumption recovering sharply - EconMin.

text.p: Spanish private consumption showed a strong recovery during the first months of the year, thanks to a rise in new jobs and a fall in the inflation rate, the Economy Ministry's latest monthly report said on Thursday.

"Private consumption, which had a relatively low trend in 1996, is showing clear signals of recovery, supported by improved confidence and better expectations, as by a progress in household revenues in real terms," the report said.

The report added that increased consumer confidence was due to improved household finances given the revaluation of financial assets (both in the stock and bond markets) and an increase in employment.
The Economy Ministry has forecast that first quarter gross domestic product grew 2.9 percent year-on-year, versus 2.6 percent in the last quarter of 1996.
